problem_statement: A tasklet that has been placed on the tasklet scheduler's run queue cannot be withdrawn or cancelled before it executes; there is no way to remove it from the queue. As a result the test suite that exercises removing queued tasklets does not compile against the current code. The required behavior: a posted tasklet must be removable from the run queue (whether it is the only posted tasklet, the first, middle, last, or all posted tasklets removed in any order), such that after removal it is no longer reported as posted, the remaining posted tasklets stay queued, the run queue reports empty when all posted tasklets are removed, no pending-tasklet signal is raised, and removing an already-unposted tasklet has no effect.
